task_description: Summarise the given news article in English.

values.instruction: Write a very brief summary using one or two sentences.
Write a summary of about two to three sentences with moderate detail.
Write a detailed summary using multiple sentences and more information.

axes.name: sentence_complexity
axes.description: 문장당 단어 수와 문장 구조의 복잡성을 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Use short and simple sentences with straightforward structure.
Use sentences of moderate length with some complexity.
Use long and complex sentences with multiple clauses.

axes.name: hedging_level
axes.description: 확실성 표현(모호함, 추측 등)의 사용 빈도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Include many hedging phrases to express uncertainty or possibility.
Use mostly definitive statements with minimal hedging.

axes.name: numerical_detail
axes.description: 숫자 및 구체적 수치 정보의 포함 정도를 나타냅니다.

values.instruction: Avoid or minimize the use of specific numbers or statistics.
Include some specific numbers or statistics where relevant.
Include many specific numbers and detailed statistics.
